text: dsh-chat-preset 为 DSH 增加名为 Chat 的对话预设，并通过补丁注册 persona、网页搜索与抓取、技能加载和基础压缩组件。新 agent 创建时，guard 会检查其可见工具，只允许已注册的 web_search、web_fetch，以及存在时的 skill；网页工具都缺失时会记录警告。预设关闭运行时上下文注入，适合需要网页问答与技能指引、同时希望限制对话工具范围的场景。安装可通过 DSH 插件命令注册；源码没有声明 API 密钥或额外账号要求。

dsh-chat-preset adds a DSH Chat preset with web search, page fetch, skill loading, and compaction. Its guard keeps available web tools and skill when an agent starts. Runtime context injection is off. It suits focused web chat with a narrower tool set.
我想给 DSH 加一个能联网搜索和阅读网页的对话模式。
让聊天 agent 只看到网页工具和可用的技能加载工具。
Can I add a DSH chat mode for web research that keeps the agent’s visible tools limited to web search, page fetch, and available skills?
dsh-chat-preset 的「Chat 对话预设」：在 DSH bundle 中注册 Chat persona、网页搜索与抓取、技能加载及基础压缩组件。用户切换到该预设后，可用网页工具查询和读取页面。
dsh-chat-preset 的「按 agent 限制工具」：agent 创建时读取其当前可见工具，仅把已注册的 web_search、web_fetch 和可选 skill 留在允许列表；找不到网页工具或读取异常时记录警告。

@local/dsh-chat-preset README · dsh-chat-preset：A DeepSeek Harness bundle that registers a `chat` agent preset: a plain helpful assistant with web access and local skills, and no way to touch the filesystem or run a command.

@local/dsh-chat-preset README · Abstract：The harness composes behaviour from bundles, presets, and plugins. This bundle adds one preset row and one guard plugin, so a session can be switched to a chat mode whose model can search, fetch, and load skill instructions, and nothing else. A preset-scope tool restriction would also filter the preset's own tools, so the restriction is applied per agent once that agent exists.

@local/dsh-chat-preset README · What it registers：One preset, mounted from [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml):

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `id` | `chat` |
| `name` | Chat |
| `order` | 5 |
| persona | helpful assistant, cites sources, marks uncertainty, never claims to have run something it did not |
| tools | `web_search`, `web_fetch`, `skill` |
| compaction | basic compaction plus `/compact` |

@local/dsh-chat-preset README · What it registers：The persona is `complete: true`, so it replaces rather than extends the host prompt, and `includeRuntimeContext` is off: chat mode does not get the workspace facts injected.

@local/dsh-chat-preset README · Why a guard instead of a config flag：The preset's own tools are registered in the shared preset scope, and the host also registers a few global tools such as `working_directory`. A restriction applied at the preset scope would filter the preset's own tools too, and would miss the globals. So the restriction is applied per agent, once the agent exists.
section: Why a guard instead of a config flag

text: @local/dsh-chat-preset README · Why a guard instead of a config flag：[`lib/guard.js`](lib/guard.js) listens for `agent/created`, reads the tools that agent can actually see, keeps `web_search` and `web_fetch`, adds `skill` when it is present, and calls `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ allow })`.
section: Why a guard instead of a config flag

text: @local/dsh-chat-preset README · Why a guard instead of a config flag：Reading the allow list from the visible tools rather than hard-coding it means a search-only or fetch-only web configuration still produces the right restriction instead of an empty one. If no web tool is registered at all, the guard logs a warning and leaves the inherited tools unrestricted, which is a deliberate failure mode: it prefers a visible configuration error over silently removing a tool the user asked for.
section: Why a guard instead of a config flag

text: @local/dsh-chat-preset README · Why the skill tool survives：`skill` reads only the skill files that the discovery provider exposes. It never resolves a workspace path, so keeping it does not widen filesystem access. Dropping it would make user-level skills unreachable in the one mode that most needs them.

@local/dsh-chat-preset README · Install：```sh
DSH_HOME=${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}
git clone https://github.com/ThomasTZh/dsh-chat-preset \
  "$DSH_HOME/local-plugins/dsh-chat-preset"
```

Register it in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json` as a dependency:

```json
"@local/dsh-chat-preset": "link:<absolute path to $DSH_HOME>/local-plugins/dsh-chat-preset"
```

and list `@local/dsh-chat-preset` in `dsh.profile.bundles`, then:

```sh
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" && pnpm install
```
@local/dsh-chat-preset README · Install：`dsh plugin --profile web add "<path-to-this-clone>"` performs the same registration through the harness CLI.

@local/dsh-chat-preset README · Limitations：- The guard restricts tools, not prompts. A chat session can still load any skill the discovery provider exposes, by design.
- The preset rows name shipped harness packages (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`, `dsh-persona`, `dsh-agent-instructions`, and the skill and compaction plugins). They are resolved from the harness install and are not vendored here.
